text:
O executing fate in my sorrows,
        how keenly I felt your rigorous laws!
        You cut the tree with hurtful hands,
        and scattered fruit and flowers upon the ground.


        In little space my loves lie fallen,
        and all the hope of all my things,
        turned into disdainful ashes,
        deaf to my complaints and cries.


        The tears that in this sepulcher
        are shed today and have been shed
        receive, though there they be of no avail to you,


        until that everlasting dark night
        closes these fair eyes of mine that saw you,
        leaving me with others who may see you.

translation.title: O executing fate in my sorrows...
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
